policy: These entries audit the named implementation premises and concrete test boundaries only. They do not claim exhaustive per-instruction corpus testing, nor discharge unlisted formal rules. Proposal overlays are identified explicitly. Direct premise coverage includes inspected delegation to typed stack/type lookup helpers; it is not recursive proof that every referenced formal rule or every boundary case has its own test.
